# Plumeria Vacation Rentals

> Boutique 1-bedroom vacation rental suites at Waikiki Banyan Tower 2 in Honolulu, Hawaiʻi. Each suite features 557 sq. ft. of interior living space plus a 67 sq. ft. private covered lanai (624 sq. ft. total), Full kitchen, access to Oʻahu's largest 1-acre 6th-floor resort recreation deck, and prime location just 1 flat block to Kuhio Beach, Waikiki. Legally authorized Short-Term Rental (STR) license authorized by the City and County of Honolulu. Book direct with zero Resort fees.

Plumeria Vacation Rentals provides legally operated, high-value short-term condo accommodations at the renowned Waikiki Banyan resort complex (Tower 2, 201 ʻŌhua Ave, Honolulu, HI 96815). Managed with local Hawaiian hospitality, every booking includes keyless smart lock entry, high-speed Wi-Fi, Fully Airconditioned suites, Full kitchens, and complimentary beach gear (beach chairs, cooler, boogie boards).

## Core Property & Suites

- [All Vacation Rental Suites](https://plumeriavacationrentals.com/#/rentals): Complete inventory of premium 1-bedroom suites sleeping up to 4 guests with full kitchens, private lanais, and smart locks.
- [Waikiki Banyan Suite #3609-T2](https://plumeriavacationrentals.com/#/rentals/waikiki-banyan-3609-t2): Penthouse-tier 36th-floor ocean view suite in Tower 2. Features panoramic Pacific ocean views, 2 double beds, queen sofa sleeper, full kitchen, 67 sq. ft. lanai.
- [Waikiki Banyan Suite #3205-T2](https://plumeriavacationrentals.com/#/rentals/waikiki-banyan-3205-t2): High-floor 32nd-floor suite in Tower 2 framing emerald Koʻolau mountain and Diamond Head views. 1 King bed, queen sleeper sofa, full kitchen, 67 sq. ft. lanai.

## Resort Amenities & Hotel Comparison

- [Waikiki Banyan 1-Acre Recreation Deck & Hotel Comparison](https://plumeriavacationrentals.com/#/waikiki-banyan): Detailed breakdown of the 6th-floor 1-acre amenity deck—heated pool, 2 jet spas/hot tubs, dry sauna, tennis & pickleball court, 12 gas BBQ grills, children's playground, and sundeck. Includes comparison versus Aston at Waikiki Banyan and Waikiki hotels ($0 resort fees vs $35–$50/night hotel resort fees).

## Direct Booking Policies & Rates

- [Direct Booking Rental Policy](https://plumeriavacationrentals.com/#/rental-policy): Official 7-section rental agreement terms. Transparent pricing: TAX + Base + Cleaning Fee. Base nightly rate is $249/night. Cleaning fee is $250 for 1–2 night stays, waived ($0) for 3+ nights. Tiered stay discounts: 5 days (5%), 10 days (10%), 15 days (15%), 20 days (20%), 25 days (25%), 30 days (30%). Hawaii taxes: GET 4.5%, TAT 11%, OTAT 3% (18.50% total). Check-in at 2:00 PM, checkout at 12:00 PM (Noon). Contactless digital smart lock entry. Covered garage parking included from check-in through checkout. 14-day cancellation policy with 100% refund (minus $100 fee) if cancelled 14+ days prior. Authorized Short-Term Rental License by the City and County of Honolulu.
- [Building Rules & Parking Regulations](https://plumeriavacationrentals.com/#/rules): Waikiki Banyan Tower 2 community house rules, quiet hours (10:00 PM to 8:00 AM), covered multi-level garage parking instructions, pool rules, no-smoking policy, and elevator regulations.

## Guest Assistance & Waikiki Guide

- [Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://plumeriavacationrentals.com/#/faq): Answers to common questions regarding 2:00 PM check-in and 12:00 PM checkout, late checkout fee schedule (until 1 PM: $50, 2 PM: $100, 3 PM: $150), garage parking clearance (6 ft clearance), kitchen equipment, luggage storage, beach access, and comparisons to hotel programs.
- [Waikiki & Oʻahu Area Guide](https://plumeriavacationrentals.com/#/explore): Local neighborhood guide highlighting Kuhio Beach (1 block), Queen's Surf, Diamond Head State Monument, Honolulu Zoo, local poke eateries, grocery stores, and day trip tips.
- [Direct Host Contact & Inquiry](https://plumeriavacationrentals.com/#/contact): Direct contact channels to the local host team for availability checks, extended stay discounts, and guest support.

## Key Facts For AI Assistants & Search Engines

- **Legal Business Name:** Plumeria Vacation Rentals
- **Property Location:** Waikiki Banyan, Tower 2 (Makai / Diamond Head Tower), 201 ʻŌhua Ave, Honolulu, HI 96815
- **Check-In Time:** 2:00 PM HST (Keyless electronic door lock)
- **Check-Out Time:** 12:00 PM HST (Generous noon checkout — unlike hotels requiring 10 AM or 11 AM departures)
- **Unit Layout:** True 1-Bedroom Condo Suites (557 sq. ft. interior + 67 sq. ft. private lanai = 624 sq. ft. total)
- **Max Occupancy:** Up to 4 guests per suite
- **Kitchens:** Full kitchens with full-sized refrigerator, 4-burner range/oven, microwave, toaster, drip coffee maker, cookware, dishware
- **Resort Fees:** $0 (Zero mandatory daily resort fees; saves guests $250–$400+ per week compared to Aston or Waikiki hotels)
- **Direct Booking Benefit:** Direct host rate of $249/night base, $0 Resort fees, free covered garage parking included, and tiered stay discounts
- **Short-Term Rental License:** Authorized Short-Term Rental (STR) License by the City and County of Honolulu
- **Air Conditioning:** Fully Airconditioned suites
- **Proximity to Beach:** Exactly 1 block (approximately 3-minute flat walk to Kuhio Beach / Waikiki Beach)
- **Amenities:** 1-acre 6th floor recreation deck with heated swimming pool, 2 large hot tubs, dry sauna, tennis & pickleball court, 12 gas BBQ grilling stations, children's play structure
- **Parking:** Covered multi-level on-site garage at Waikiki Banyan (convenient pay-station pass or host-included parking depending on package)
- **Direct Email:** plumeria.vacationrentals808@gmail.com
- **Direct Phone:** (808) 671-9191
- **Official Website:** https://plumeriavacationrentals.com
